# secureaccess_destination_list (Data Source)

This data source reads the Destination List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_destination_list" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Id of the object

### Read-Only

- `destinations` (Attributes Set) List of destinations in the Destination List (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `name` (String) Name of the Destination List.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment for the destination.
- `destination` (String) The destination value (domain name, URL, or IPv4 address).
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier for the destination.
- `type` (String) Type of the destination.
